identificationModule.briefTitle: Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder With MK0869 (0869-068)(COMPLETED)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study of the Long-Term Efficacy of MK0869 in the Maintenance of Antidepressant Effect in Geriatric Outpatients With Major Depressive Disorder

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A clinical study to determine the efficacy and safety of an investigational medication (MK0869) in the treatment of depression.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The duration of treatment is 10 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.measure: HAMD-17 score </= 10 after 10 weeks; maintenance of antidepressant effect for 6-10 months; tolerability

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CGI-S score change from Week 10 at Month 6; HAMD-17 total score change from Week 10 at Month 6; MADRS total score change at Month 6, HAMA total score change at Month 6
